messages:
maria_infra: heads-up — seeing repeated tail-latency spikes (p95->p999) on eu2-dedicated during nightly mlprep windows. looks like short NIC/interrupt storms rather than GPU saturation. anyone else noticing?
kevin_ops: saw that in the dashboard at ~00:15 UTC. spikes coincide with a small cohort of tenants sending lots of 1-3 token requests. noisy small-RPC pattern?
anya_ml: interesting — could be kvcache churn + nvlink/io contention. can you paste a sample of the pcap or sockstat?
kevin_ops: attaching quick grep from node logs: `queue_len spikes: 120->900 in 30s`, `irq_affinity_mismatch` in dmesg. also ethtool shows tx-queue queueing on eth0: `tx_busy` going high.
sam_sre: alloc-bot alert triggered 00:14:52: "EGRESS_HEADROOM_LOW eu2-pool-dedicated-42". alloc-bot: tenant burst detected, fallback throttle engaged in 3 nodes.
alloc-bot: ALERT: egress_headroom < 10% for pool eu2-dedicated-42. fallback routing applied to preemptible_bin for 12 requests/min. See /ops/alloc/events/1812345.
maria_infra: thanks — so it's egress headroom + interrupt storm from bursts of tiny requests. two levers: 1) stopgap: soft-carve small quiet reserve for noisy-tenants (soft-reserve = 3% pool) 2) longer: NIC QoS + irqbalance tuning on hot racks.
anya_ml: propose new metric: tenant_tail_ratio = (#requests p999 / #requests p95) per tenant over 5m. flag if > 3 and avg payload < 8 tokens. we can run offline on last 24h and backfill.
kevin_ops: +1. can we do soft-reserve rollout as a canary? idea: auto-create a fractional dedicated carve (quiet-reserve) that absorbs tiny-RPC floods and gives them dedicated egress lanes, so they don't trample kvcache warmth.
sam_sre: concerned about cost — carving reduces usable pool for big models. suggest policy: soft-reserve kicks in only if tenant_tail_ratio>threshold AND overall pool utilization>70%. also auto-reclaim after 15m quiet.
maria_infra: agree. action items: (1) kevin to prototype soft-reserve controller (2h) and a canary on eu2-rack12 with 2 nodes; (2) anya to implement tenant_tail_ratio query on telemetry (ql) and run historical scan; (3) sam to draft cost SLO for reserving 3% and fallback reclaim rules.
kevin_ops: quick command i'll use for debugging on a node: ```sudo perf record -e interrupts -a -- sleep 30; sudo ethtool -S eth0 | grep tx_busy``` will give irq vs tx stats. also i'll enable `irqbalance` sticky on rack12 for canary.
anya_ml: i'll push a ql snippet by EOD and share threshold suggestions. initial threshold: tenant_tail_ratio >= 4 and median_payload_tokens <= 6.
sam_sre: if canary looks good, we should run soft-reserve for 48h and monitor p999->p95 slope, cost delta, and SLA impact. set alert: >10% p999 increase post-rollout for non-noisy tenants -> rollback.
maria_infra: +1. kevin, create the canary ticket and tag me. i'll coordinate ops window at 23:30 UTC tonight.
kevin_ops: created ticket INFRA-4821 and added runbook steps. will post status in this thread when canary is live. :thumbsup:
alloc-bot: NOTE: will suppress auto-fallback during soft-reserve canary for affected nodes to avoid double-routing.
maria_infra: thanks all. keeping this thread open for canary updates.
